title: CondRxnBench-Core v0.1 canonical CSV schema
scope: The two HTE main matrices and their already enumerated strict single-factor pairs. Benchmark splits and cliff labels are intentionally not assigned in this release.

zero_yield.rule: true only when yield_observed is true and yield_percent equals 0

yield_type.rule: Never compare absolute yields across source_dataset without stratification.

success_label.rule: A success threshold is a later benchmark decision.

rules: Both endpoints belong to the same strict reaction_group_id.
n_changed_factors equals 1 for every Core v0.1 pair.
cliff_label is not_assigned until a pre-registered threshold policy is released.
